decision.reason: [ev-96b59d041e80] says only that stats tags configuration was added for watchdog metrics. The linked issue [ev-4c3e806736ac] reports that watchdog stat extraction was "broken" and shows per-worker metric names such as envoy_server_worker_0_watchdog_miss. That points to a fix that changes extraction by default, not a feature operators have to turn on. So the claim that deployments are "unaffected unless they choose to configure it" has no support, but the evidence also never states the new metric names or labels, or whether existing scrapes or dashboards break. To decide between none and behavior-change, I need the PR diff or a description showing the default tag regex and the resulting metric names.
